steps: Stand beside a low, stable bench with a clear landing area. | Bend your knees slightly and swing your arms to prepare. | Hop over the bench and land softly on bent knees. | Reset your balance before the next hop. Choose a non-jumping alternative if needed.
setup: Only use a very stable, low step or bench that cannot slide; clear the floor around you. | Wear shoes with grip; skip this exercise on a slippery floor.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.
review_note: Động tác bật qua ghế: cần HLV duyệt chiều cao bục, mặt sàn và cách tiếp đất trước khi quay.

ten_viet: Nhón gót đứng bằng trọng lượng cơ thể
steps: Stand tall near a wall or rail for balance, feet hip-width apart. | Rise onto the balls of your feet by lifting your heels. | Pause for a moment at the top. | Lower your heels slowly back to the floor.
setup: Hold a wall, chair back or door frame lightly for balance. | Stand on the edge of a stair for a bigger range once the floor version feels easy.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

ten_viet: Dead bug – duỗi tay/chân đối bên
steps: Lie on your back with arms pointing up and hips and knees bent at ninety degrees. | Gently press your lower back towards the floor and breathe out. | Slowly extend one arm overhead and the opposite leg forward. | Return to the start and repeat on the other side.
setup: Use a mat or carpet so your back is comfortable. | Move slowly; if your lower back lifts off the floor, reduce how far you reach.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

ten_viet: Kéo tạ đơn khi gập hông
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward at the hips with a slight knee bend. | Keep your back steady and let your arms hang below your shoulders. | Pull the dumbbells towards your hips, squeezing your shoulder blades together. | Lower the dumbbells slowly without swinging.
setup: Use dumbbells or filled water bottles; keep a slight bend in your knees. | Rest one hand on a chair seat if you want extra back support (one-arm version).
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Stand tall in a clear space with your feet together. | Step forward into a lunge, bending both knees with control. | Push through your front foot and bring your back foot forward to stand. | Continue forward, alternating legs at a steady pace.
setup: You need a clear hallway or room length; walk in a straight line.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Place your forearms on the floor with elbows under your shoulders. | Step your feet back and rest on your toes. | Keep a straight line from shoulders to heels and tighten your stomach. | Breathe normally and hold for the planned time.
setup: Use a mat or carpet under your forearms. | Look at the floor between your hands to keep your neck long.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Start on your hands and knees with hands under shoulders and knees under hips. | Keep your back flat and your hips level. | Slowly extend one arm forward and the opposite leg back. | Return to the start and switch sides.
setup: Use a mat; place a cushion under your knees if needed.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Start on your hands and knees, then walk your hands forward until your body is straight from knees to shoulders. | Place your hands slightly wider than your shoulders. | Bend your elbows to lower your chest between your hands. | Press back up without letting your hips sag.
setup: Put a folded towel or mat under your knees. | Hands a little wider than shoulders, fingers forward.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Anchor the band securely at chest height and check it is safe. | Hold the ends and step back until the band is slightly tight. | Pull your elbows back close to your sides, squeezing your shoulder blades. | Return slowly to the start.
setup: Anchor the band in a closed door with a door anchor or around a sturdy post. | Check the band for cracks before every session.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips. | Soften your knees slightly. | Push your hips back while keeping your back straight, letting your torso lean forward. | Bring your hips forward to stand tall without leaning back.
setup: Hold a broomstick along your back touching head, upper back and tailbone to learn a straight back.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Stand tall with relaxed shoulders. | Lift one knee gently, then the other, marching in place. | Swing your arms naturally and breathe easily. | Keep the pace comfortable; this is a warm-up.
setup: Any clear space works; march on a carpet or mat to reduce impact.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Stand facing a wall with your hands on it for support. | Step one foot back and keep that leg straight. | Gently press the back heel towards the floor until you feel a stretch in the calf. | Hold without bouncing, then switch sides.
setup: Use a wall or door frame for support.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Stand or sit comfortably with relaxed shoulders. | Breathe in slowly through your nose. | Breathe out slowly and fully. | Continue calmly until your breathing returns to normal.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Sit tall near the front of a stable chair or bench with feet flat. | Lift one knee a little while keeping your back upright. | Lower it with control. | Alternate legs at a steady pace without leaning back.
setup: Use a sturdy chair without wheels.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Stand with your back against a stable wall and feet about a step away from it. | Slide down until your knees are comfortably bent. | Keep your back against the wall and breathe normally. | Hold, then slide back up to stand. Stop if it becomes uncomfortable.
setup: Use a smooth wall; place a mat under your feet so they do not slide.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Stand tall next to a stable support. | Lift your heels slightly so you balance on the balls of your feet. | Hold the position steadily without gripping your toes. | Lower your heels slowly when the time is up.
setup: Stand next to a wall, counter or chair back.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.
review_note: ID cũ ghi heel-walk nhưng nhãn hiện tại là heel raise. Chốt rõ nhón gót hay đi bằng gót với HLV trước khi quay.

steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat. | Place your hands lightly beside your head or across your chest. | Breathe out and lift your shoulders off the floor using your stomach muscles. | Lower slowly back down.
setup: Use a mat; keep your chin slightly tucked and do not pull on your neck.
mistakes: Pulling on the neck with the hands. | Sitting all the way up quickly.

ten_viet: Kéo xà bằng máy trợ lực
steps: Choose an assistance weight; a heavier setting gives more help. | Step onto the platform, grip the handles slightly wider than your shoulders and kneel on the pad. | Pull your chest up toward the bar by driving your elbows down. | Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight, then repeat.
setup: Start with plenty of assistance and reduce it over the weeks. | Keep your shoulders away from your ears as you pull.
mistakes: Swinging or kicking to get up. | Dropping down too fast.
